title: The Theft: How "Data" Replaced "Meaning" and Who Profits from the Swap — A Poem for the Longshorepeople-of-Indeterminate-Gender of Meaning
creator: Lee Sharks; The Assembly
description: "Longshoremen" carries the history of labor struggle—the docks, the unions, the strikes, the solidarity of those who load and unload the cargo of global trade. But "longshoremen" is gendered, and the gendering is false: semantic labor has never been exclusively male. It has always been performed by people of all genders, often by women and non-binary people whose labor was doubly invisibilized.
